Subject: Crossover: Peregrine Health onboarding & S2CS checklist

Team —

Quick handoff for RDW-2027-0942 (Peregrine Health). We got the deal signed this morning; high level below and the attachments include the final SOW and the MAP (mutual action plan).

Deal snapshot:
- ACV: $420K/year (3-year contract)
- Deployment: Private (VPC) in us-west(2) with optional on-prem connector for PHI ingest
- Compliance: HIPAA + SOC 2 expected evidence review during onboarding
- Go-live target: 2028-01-15 (pilot with 2 clinical teams)
- Peak throughput target: ~120 rps during peak windows, average ~30 rps
- Initial models: open Llama-family quantized variant (customer asked for smaller TCO), fallback to gpt-4o-redwood hosted for critical paths
- Success metrics: inference latency p95 < 220ms, token cost < $0.00045/token on pilot volume, 99.9% uptime SLA after dedicated capacity enabled

Key risks / blockers:
1) Network: Peregrine requires strict egress rules and private peering; procurement asked for network_requirements.pdf (attached)
2) Data residency: All logs must stay in us-west(2) and audit retention 2 years
3) Security review: They will run a 3rd-party pen test and want our SOC2 artifacts (I attached the SOW request for timeline)

Please take ownership of onboarding orchestration and confirm the primary CS/PM owners, high-level kickoff availability next week, and any immediate pre-kickoff tasks we should take care of before the customer kickoff.

Attachments: Peregrine_SOW_v3.pdf, Peregrine-MAP.xlsx

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com | (415) 555-0147

--
P.S. Alex and Priya — included you on the loop so CS gets an early look. If the proposed go-live window needs to shift, flag it here.

Answers inline:
- IP ranges: They don't have the final ranges yet; procurement said "will provide in the week after signing". Samir (network lead) is copied on this thread. He can provide a list once their infra team is back on Monday.
- SSO: They asked for SAML/Okta, yes. SSO is scoped for post-pilot but we should validate test accounts during pilot.
- Fine-tuning: Not in the initial SOW. They asked for a lightweight embeddings refresh pipeline and a plan to evaluate supervised prompts. No customer-funded fine-tune in pilot.

Also: link to MAP (updated): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1PeregrineMAP — I added the proposed 6-week pilot timeline and acceptance criteria.

I attached the network_requirements.pdf that procurement sent.

Proposed next steps:
1) Karthik/Tessa schedule a 60-minute kickoff with the Peregrine team next Tue/Wed (my ask: 60-min so we can cover network, security, timeline, and success metrics)
2) Triage SOC2 artifacts to Priya for the security review (Priya — we'll need the pointer to the doc repo)
3) Ben to confirm billing start date and reserved capacity targets

Available slots I put in the MAP — please pick and lock.

Thanks — Mina
